info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Fitness Memberships Renew-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Renewal Management API facilitates the seamless updating of fitness membership renewals. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify existing membership information, ensuring members have uninterrupted access to their fitness services. Typical consumers include gym administrators and fitness club managers who need to manage member renewals efficiently. By providing this API, organizations can enhance member satisfaction and streamline operational processes related to membership management.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to renew their existing membership. It updates the membership's expiration date and ensures uninterrupted access to member benefits.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to renew a membership. It should contain the necessary details required for the renewal process in a JSON format.
